property_summary: For any admissible input that does not revert, the transfer function must return true; the mutant returns false, violating this rule.
For any admissible input where transfer completes without reverting, its return value must be true; the mutant returns false when it completes, violating this rule.
For any input where the loop of low-level calls succeeds without reverting, the transfer function must return true; the mutant returns false even when all calls succeed.
